name: Tiled Ray Marching with Grid Sampling
definition: Renders a single view of a 3D volume by generating rays, sampling density via grid_sample, and accumulating attenuation. It supports tiling to manage memory usage for large images.
summary: Tiled Ray Marching with Grid Sampling renders 3D volumes by processing image tiles to manage memory, using fixed-step grid interpolation instead of analytic cell-boundary traversal.
